answer: A payout is split thus 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The gale schedule is applied in hollow and grove exposes each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4919 identities would post 2839 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
